objective: Dynamic maritime situation -> observable candidate response -> online planner choice/replan -> actual continued navigation; preserve user original research direction

supervisor.predictor: Explicit approximate planar nominal mass/damping + exact .1s shaft lag, uses P002 controller preview and current internal state; not full BOTH prediction and not formal safety proof
supervisor.fallback: Zero relative-water speed and retained shaped heading; frozen controller shapes braking, integrals frozen during override; vessel/shaft/filter/observation/receiver state retained
supervisor.triggers: Every control tick: projected actual execution unsafe, delivered no_solution, or no fresh reference after initial wait. Pending job outcome must not trigger before ready/delivery. Ordinary invalid/stale packets rejected by frozen receiver; fresh is not proof of geometric safety.
supervisor.recovery: TRACK requires fresh native guidance and normal/stop previews >=3.5m continuously .5s. Independent COMMON_RECOVERY may start a low-speed fragment after measured ready time using fresh public sensing and current-state action+terminal-stop revalidation; never execute expired native guidance.
supervisor.observer_truth_separation: Public delayed estimates, observed object tracks, known map/bounds and idealized current shaft telemetry only; hidden/future world used solely for plant and offline metric evaluation.
supervisor.geometry: Use frozen p003_sweep_interval analytic circle sweep on endpoint polylines; physical path from frozen BOTH RK4sub4, not continuous nonlinear ODE certificate
supervisor.initial_wait_policy: Before .5s startup wait has zero speed fallback but no missing-reference latch; geometry/no_solution can still latch. At/after.5s no fresh reference triggers supervision. This does not extend active TTL.

candidate_contract.speed_semantics: commanded signed water-relative surge; search0to1.2; ground prediction includes current public flow
candidate_contract.future_flow: hold current delayed public measurement only
candidate_contract.static_information: known map plus detected static memory
candidate_contract.moving_information: current observed center/velocity/timestamp only; no future schedules
candidate_contract.astar_scope: Public bounded snapshot map to common goal, fully replanned at each decision; exact safe grid connectors and snapshot LOS; not a cached local25m-connection planner or time-space safety guarantee.

sensors.flow_estimate: ideal measured flow vector at same delayed timestamp as ego and objects; not a real estimator
sensors.ego_noise: P0 frozen u/v/yaw/r scales; independent tape indexed by absolute tick

world.current_schedule_interpolation: linear in VN,VE; value at interval left endpoint held across frozen .05s/RK4sub4 step
world.current_model_scope: time-varying spatially uniform current parameters; frozen yaw nu_c_dot retained, no added force for temporal current acceleration; not a validated ocean/wind/wave model
world.ship_velocity_schedule_interpolation: right-continuous piecewise constant; integrate each segment from spawn
world.pre_dynamic_repair: Before any dynamic episode: shift CROSS01 N+20m, retain CROSS02 westward motion, remove third ship, preventing background vessels traversing static rectangles or each other. Original v02 full text and geometric audit retained.
world.polarity_extension: D3W shares every D3 physical/noise/world input at same seed except VN,VE signs are both reversed at all times; metadata labels differ. No promise of a different winner.

recovery.integrals: frozen during BRAKE/RECOVER; filter, shaft and physical state advance normally
recovery.planning_delivery: measured search CPU counted; cannot apply a nonconstant recovery plan before its ready_time; BRAKE remains available while waiting
recovery.independent_reference_source: COMMON_RECOVERY action may replace expired/rejected native guidance only when generated from fresh public sensing, separately delivered no earlier than measured ready time, and rechecked using current public state; fresh valid native still required for TRACK
recovery.no_solution_delivery: A delivered no_solution forces BRAKE for that control tick and forbids pending recovery acceptance on that same tick; later fresh common recovery remains allowed

judge.model_scope: same public nominal execution predictor; not true future or an optimal oracle

selection.delivery: max(sum of actual invoked candidate+selection CPU,injected .05s), with world advancing until actual ready event
selection.background_cost: all shadow candidate calls and judge work explicitly counted; fixed native baselines do not receive free alternate plans

logging.jobs_and_packets: complete JSON with public launch snapshot/ready times and all candidates/scores
logging.prediction_storage: lossless MAT arrays or cells for all tick forecasts, optional gzip JSON developer export; never single-success-window-only
logging.failed_attempts: unique directories and source freezes, preserve partial logs; no overwrite
logging.large_remote_artifacts: Untracked artifacts over45MiB may be published as byte-exact24MiB parts with original bytes+SHA256 manifest; original retained locally, fully reconstructable remotely, no downsampling or content loss.

no_claims: actual electric energy without power model
analysis.polarity_priority: After firstD3 independent verification, run D3W seed101 all5 before remaining D1/D2; reserve201-203 for later unchanged-algorithm paired worlds.

timing_measurement_definition: MATLAB tic/toc per-call elapsed duration, including scheduling effects; historical *_cpu_s field names retained. Candidate and judge sum and recovery search ready are delayed; this is not OS process-only CPU or a complete real-time scheduler.
